title: Shared shortened-tail decoding with exact low-bank role allocation

claims.statement: The explicit product of thirty [64,32] components and the shortened 40-bit data tail, decoded by the shared-table program on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses, has average block error at most 99996194843309465048853483363353/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=279 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(124819/15364).

experiments.purpose: Recompute the wide sector and low-bank minimum-weight pair counts, the zero-byte parity subset, and the exact wide/tail probability product. Sector zero also replays four fixed decoder inputs.
